subject: Take-home assignment: systems prompt + reviewer schedule
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khatri <samir.khatri@gmail.com>, Olivia Ramos <olivia.ramos@talentbridge.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 Mar 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Take-home assignment: systems prompt + reviewer schedule

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for taking the next step with Redwood. Attached is the take-home prompt for the Senior Infra Engineer role. Please review the instructions in the PDF (Redwood_Takehome_Prompt.pdf) and submit a ZIP containing your write-up and any code via reply to this thread or by uploading to the Google Doc linked below.

Key details:
- What to do: Design a small distributed inference service and provide a short implementation prototype (see PDF for scope).
- Deliverables: design doc (PDF or MD), prototype code (link or ZIP), short runbook with test cases.
- Deadline: end of day PT on Wednesday, 19 Mar 2025 (we can extend if needed).
- Reviewers & timing: Lauren will handle systems/design review; Dylan will focus on code and end-to-end validation. We plan to review on Tue 18 Mar between 1:00–4:00 PM PT; please aim to submit by EOD Mon 17 Mar if possible so reviewers have time.

Upload link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Xy_takehome_prompt
(Attached: Redwood_Takehome_Prompt.pdf)

If anything is unclear, reply here or DM me. Olivia — thanks for coordinating timing with Samir; please confirm candidate availability.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

From: Samir Khatri <samir.khatri@gmail.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Olivia Ramos <olivia.ramos@talentbridge.io>
Date: Sat, 15 Mar 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Take-home assignment: systems prompt + reviewer schedule

Hi Mina / Olivia —

Thanks for sending this over. I received the PDF and the doc link. Quick question: is it okay if the prototype is in Go or should it be Python only? Also, are we allowed to use small external libraries (e.g., grpc, http frameworks) or should everything be handwritten?

I expect to start on this tonight and was hoping to keep the Monday target; if something unexpected comes up I may ask for a short extension.

Thanks,
Samir

---

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khatri <samir.khatri@gmail.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Olivia Ramos <olivia.ramos@talentbridge.io>
Date: Sat, 15 Mar 2025 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Take-home assignment: systems prompt + reviewer schedule

Hi Samir —

Go is totally fine (we have reviewers comfortable with both Go and Python). Small, well-documented libraries are allowed — focus on correctness and clarity over re-implementing infra primitives. If you use any non-standard dependencies, include a short note in the runbook about why and how to install/run.

Regarding timeline — Monday EOD is preferred so we can run an initial pass on Tue 18 Mar. If you need a short extension, let me know by Monday morning and we'll accommodate.

Lauren / Dylan / Aditya: can you confirm you can block 1:00–3:00 PM PT on Tue 18 Mar for a consolidated review session? I'll create a calendar hold.

Thanks —
Mina

Mina —

I can take lead on the design review. Blocked 1:00–3:00 PM PT on Tue 18 Mar on my calendar (calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=review-block-20250318).

I've attached the lightweight rubric I'll use (Reviewer_Rubric.md) — it covers clarity of requirements, tradeoff discussion, scalability considerations, and testing plan. Dylan, can you confirm you have a slot at 2:00 PM to run the prototype? If not, we can split the session.

Thanks,
Lauren
Senior Staff Engineer, Redwood Inference
